name: Aoi no Sekai de Tokeiku
source:
With only one month left to live, Aoi enters the cursed mansion.

But there, his purpose shifts—from death toward life.

This is a story that carefully follows his emotional struggle and growth

as he begins to fight for survival.

When the final moment arrives…

will the one standing before him be a human, a ghost, or something else entirely?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4407510/Melting_into_Aois_World/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
仅剩一个月寿命的葵，踏入了那栋受诅咒的洋馆。

然而在那里，他的目标却悄然转变——从求死走向了求生。

这是一部细腻描绘他开始为生存抗争时，内心挣扎与蜕变成长的故事。

当最后的时刻来临之际……

站在他面前的，究竟会是人类、幽灵，还是某种截然不同的存在？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4407510/Melting_into_Aois_World/]Steam[/url]]
